S195-02: added the missing native Linux client build (build.sh's command was never run in CI), same SDL2-bundling fix as PITVIPER, and a real auto-release job matching PARENA's cadence but non-prerelease (a deliberate departure -- PARENA's own releases ARE prerelease, flagged separately as S195-03). Real CI run green (commit 8f36fce), real release v0.1.0 confirmed via API: prerelease=false, correct assets.

title: Native Linux client build + non-prerelease auto-release — CI-verified
